description:
Position Overview

ETH Zurich advertises a doctoral position on generative AI-based computational design methods for engineering. The successful candidate will develop and study machine-learning methods that support and automate engineering design workflows, connecting generative models with domain-specific simulation and optimisation tools.

The position suits candidates excited about the intersection of large generative models, geometry and engineering practice, and offers a fully funded doctoral contract at one of the leading technical universities in Europe.

Research Areas

  • Generative AI models for engineering design tasks
  • Computational design pipelines and surrogate modelling
  • Integration of machine learning with simulation and optimisation
  • Evaluation of AI-designed solutions in real engineering settings

Apply through the official ETH Zurich job portal before 1 November 2026 using the application button on the advert. Applications typically include a CV, transcripts, a cover letter describing research interests and contact details for references.

About ETH Zurich

ETH Zurich is one of the world's leading universities in science and technology. Doctoral candidates benefit from structured doctoral education, world-class laboratories and a research community that spans engineering, computer science and the natural sciences.
